scope: Independent visual review of all20 original whole H1a screenshots only. No runtime interactions, source edits, image processing or alteration of prior evidence.
visualSequence: clear/red-orange/blue/red-orange/blue, all four offsets in each phase
timerChangesVerified: Each phase independently shows00:08,00:07,00:05,00:01 at the four captures; timer resets at following phase.
progressChangesVerified: Green bar advances from a short initial segment to nearly full by final image; progression remains visible while both highlight directions render correctly. Qualitative visual judgment only, no pixel measurements.
visibleArtifacts: No board or control rendering defect observed. A tiny dark lower-left boundary mark is consistently present outside the tested UI; no cause inferred.
meaning: Live timer/progress sibling presentation did not reproduce the highlight failure in these20 isolated E-based frames. This is not a repair proof or pass for the normal workout.
